li.label: my apprentice stayed
li.description: The youngster I taught all season asked to stay, and stayed. There are two of us at the bench now, and one of us is still learning.

li.label: sent my apprentice home a journeyman
li.description: The youngster from the town went home with a trade and a set of our old tools. Somewhere down the road, someone is going to sit on a chair I taught them to make.

li.label: lost my apprentice
li.description: Half a season of teaching, and the youngster is gone before the work was done. The half-made pieces are still on my bench.

li.label: what I taught got a town through
li.description: The traveler I nursed through the fever took what I knew back to the town, and the town came through it. I'd like to know how many.

li.label: our medicine got a town through a fever
li.description: We sent our medicine down the road to a town with a fever in it, and word came back that it got them through. It's a strange thing to have done from this far away.

li.label: we kept the gate shut on a sick town
li.description: A whole town had the fever, and the one who came to ask was a traveler we'd helped ourselves. We kept the gate shut. I keep wondering what our medicine would have done there.
